name: vocab-bloom-hub
description: A self-hosted English dictionary: 300 000 entries with meanings, examples, forms, translations and word links behind a public API, an admin UI, two SDKs, a website and an open dataset.

paragraphs: A self-hosted English dictionary: the project's own 300 000 entries with meanings, examples, forms, translations and word links, the English Wiktionary and WordNet as further datasets, dictionaries of your own — behind a public API, an admin UI, two SDKs and a website.

whatItDoes.text: A self-hosted English dictionary: the project's own 300 000 entries with meanings, examples, forms, translations and word links, the English Wiktionary and WordNet as further datasets, dictionaries of your own — behind a public API, an admin UI, two SDKs and a website.

requirements.text: A self-hosted English dictionary: the project's own 300 000 entries with meanings, examples, forms, translations and word links, the English Wiktionary and WordNet as further datasets, dictionaries of your own — behind a public API, an admin UI, two SDKs and a website.
Open .env and set two passwords: ADMINPASSWORD (the admin login) and POSTGRESPASSWORD (the bundled database).
GET /api/ready answers 503 until it is in and 200 after; then sign in with ADMINUSERNAME / ADMINPASSWORD from .env.
